TLINE.TDLINE: &TITLE&
View Stored Role SOD Results
&PURPOSE&
The results of a specific role SOD analysis are given as 'Result ID'.
This report can show the results of a single Result ID.
&INTEGRATION&
&PREREQUISITES&
&FEATURES&
&SELECTION&
The selection screen allows you to restrict the results of a single
Result ID by Conflict, Role, Role Business Area.
In the Maximum Expansion level you can select to what level the results
can be expanded and will be included in exports and downloads.
The Role Selection area can be used to determine for which roles you
want to see results based on wether or not they had conflicts during the
analysis.
&STANDARD_VARIANTS&
&OUTPUT&
The results will be presented in a tree format.
The first level of the tree contains all the roles
The second level contains all the conflicts.
The third level contains all the functions.
The fourth level contains
,, The Transactions, Objects, Fields and values causing the function
,, The Org Levels the role has access to for these functions (if any)
The fifth level contains the Objects, fields and Values that give the
role access to these Org Levels
,,The Variable Elements the role has access to for these functions (if
any)
Export Options
The Output data can be exported with the three different options by
clicking on Export button.
Export Data to ALV - The output data will be displayed in ALV format.
Export Data to Local File - The output data will be exported to a Local
file. A dialog box will appear to select the File location on the Local
PC. If the number of records in the output is greater than the value of
parameter SOD_EXPORT_ALV_LIMIT, the data will be splitted into multiple
files depending upon the parameter value.
Export Data to Server - The output data will be stored on application
server path in files. Enter the Application Server path and the Batch
Size(Records). Data will be stored in the multiple files on the server
path based on the value mentioned in Batch size(Records) field. A
background job will be scheduled and store the data on server path.
Note: The server path(directory) has to be created to store the files.
